editorial.blurb: Chodang Tofu House serves some of the most authentic, soul-warming Korean comfort food around—their soondubu and banchan are absolutely worth the drive.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Kimchi + Pork Soondubu Jjigae and ask for it spicy (go for 4/5 if you like heat); it's perfectly positioned near O'Hare if you need a quick pre-flight meal, but arrive early as this spot draws devoted regulars.

topDishes.note: Silky tofu in rich, flavorful broth with savory pork—the must-try
Amazing flavor with perfectly balanced spice
Tender, well-marinated, packed with sweet-savory depth
